headline: Oil, a rate hike and a bigger Ontario deficit define the week
summary: The Iran war pushed oil to its highest since April and helped prompt the Bank of Canada's first hike since 2023, even as the economy stalled. Ontario's deficit grew to $16.9 billion, U.S. tariffs shifted again, and the U.S. heads to the polls Tuesday.

top.headline: Oil tops US$117 as Hormuz tanker attacks continue
top.what: Brent rose about 15% in October to near US$118 as tankers were hit, including by limpet mines, and Washington kept strikes on Iran on the table.
top.why: It keeps Ontario fuel and grocery costs high and drives inflation.

top.headline: Bank of Canada hikes to 2.50% as economy stalls
top.what: The bank raised rates for the first time since 2023, then data showed August GDP flat and September likely down 0.1%.
top.why: Borrowing costs rise just as growth fades.

top.headline: Ontario deficit grows to $16.9 billion
top.what: The fall update raised this year's deficit, cut growth to 0.5% and pushed balance to 2029-30.
top.why: It limits Queen's Park's room for relief and signals a weak provincial economy.

top.headline: Tariff list shifts as Carney widens trade push
top.what: U.S. talks on steel and autos stalled, a revised 50% tariff list took effect Oct. 30, and Ottawa deepened ties with the UAE and EU.

top.headline: Senate control a toss-up heading into Nov. 3
top.what: Polls tightened in key states and forecasters call the Senate a toss-up.
top.why: The result shapes U.S. trade and Iran policy that affects Canada.

top.headline: Chow re-elected; several GTA mayors ousted
top.what: Toronto re-elected Olivia Chow while Mississauga, Hamilton, Oakville and Milton chose new mayors.
top.why: New councils set taxes, transit and housing for four years.

top.headline: Israel's vote leaves no majority for Netanyahu
top.what: Final results gave Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats and Eisenkot's 48, setting up long coalition talks.
top.why: The outcome affects the Iran war and oil prices.

top.headline: Warrant issued after violent Bridle Path home invasion
top.what: Three masked men shot and beat members of a family in North York; police have now named a 23-year-old suspect.
top.why: Toronto home invasions are up about a third this year.
